'''Vaverone Zare''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] living around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was sent to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to retrieve the [[Darth Nihilus' holocron|holocron]] of [[Darth Nihilus]], all the while attempting to beat the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nariel Pridence]] to the prize.

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Zare came to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in search of the [[Darth Nihilus' holocron|holocron]] of [[Darth Nihilus]], which was in the possession of the gangster [[Diago Hixan]]. Zare sought to make contact with Diago by sending [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] to raid his spice warehouse on the edge of the [[Jundland]]. At the same time, a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]] seeking a sensor computer from Diago, investigated on behalf of Diago's lieutenant, [[Tookreek]], to claim a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] fang. Zare attempted to persuade the smuggler to arrange a meeting with Diago, but was refused, forcing her to disarm her opponent. She spared the smuggler, leaving with a reminder that her offer was still open.<ref name="BO" />

Zare later sent Imperial commandos to attack [[Diago Hixan's palace|Diago's summer palace]], where the smuggler was meeting with Tookreek. After the smuggler fended off the attack, Zare contacted them via holo, restating her offer, but again was refused, forcing her to order a renewed attack, but the smuggler survived that too.<ref name="BO" />

Zare eventually tracked the smuggler to Diago's oasis, called the [[Lightspring]], where Jedi Knight [[Nariel Pridence]] was waiting. Additionally, Diago's delirium compelled to order his droids to kill on sight, resulting in an all out brawl between all four parties. Zare was killed in the fighting, along with Diago.<ref name="TL" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
If the smuggler player character is a male and sided with Zare against Pridence, he can become intimate with her. A smuggler who chose to side with Zare would later receive a message from her. In the message, Zare told the player that she took on the title "Darth Alluress" after retrieving the holocron. A neutral option of ignoring both can be chosen, that results in Zare's victory as well.<ref name="TL" />
